text: Press any key to accept the terms. All of them.
Pressing any key constitutes a binding signature. Take your time.
Press any key to confirm you have read the terms. You have not.
Bring back anything valuable. That does not include you.
Tether secured. Please do not read that as a promise.
The trench is dark, cold and full of money. You may keep the first two.
Your shift starts now. Your pay starts when I decide.
Down you go. Come back heavier, or do not. Both are billable.
Swim. It was the only skill on your application we could verify.
Swim with purpose. I measure purpose in credits.
Grab salvage. Ownership transfers on contact. To me.
Grab salvage. It is the only thing that restores my patience.
The winch brings you home. It is loud. Things below will notice.
Hold the winch and I reel you in. Gently, if you are carrying anything.
Your lamp. Point it at what you want to see, or want to stop seeing.
The lamp is standard issue. So is the dark.
Something good beyond the tether? Ask me to cut you loose. I will not hesitate.
Request the cut at any time. It is the only request I approve.
Lovely. Forty percent of that is already mine.
Your first find. Forty percent is mine. We will discuss the rest at settlement.
Noted. Filed. Mildly appreciated.
That almost covers the oxygen you used to fetch it.
Pocket change. I will still count it twice.
Acceptable. I have updated your file from disappointing to pending.
Good. That nearly pays for your training. There was no training.
Respectable. Mind the weight. It is mine, but you are carrying it.
Now that is worth the paperwork.
Excellent. I feel something. I believe it is margin.
Splendid. I have insured it for more than I insured you.
Superb. I will mention you in the quarterly report. As a footnote.
A pearl. Just out of reach. I could fix that for you.
That is beyond your tether. Your tether, however, is negotiable.
Pretty. Ask me to cut you loose. Thirty seconds of air is plenty, on paper.
You are sinking. The salvage is fine, which is the main thing.
You appear to be descending without authorisation.
Greed is heavy. I admire it from up here.
Overloaded. Swimming up is now a theory. The winch is a fact.
End of the line. I mean that contractually.
That is all the tether you get. I can always offer less.
This is as far as the company goes. Beyond here, you are freelance.
Winching. Hold still and try to look like cargo.
Retrieving company property. And you.
That is loud. I am sure nothing heard it.
Coming up already? Your timesheet will reflect that.
Half my patience remains. This is a courtesy notice.
You are halfway through my patience. Salvage helps. Excuses do not.
Fifty percent. Let us call this your mid-dive review.
A quarter of my patience left. Spend it on something shiny.
I am beginning to reconsider our arrangement.
Twenty-five percent. I have started drafting your exit interview.
Your tether is starting to look like a cost centre.
Ten percent. Find me something valuable, or find the airlock.
My hand is on the cutter. Figuratively. I do not have hands.
Consider this your final notice.
Nearly out of patience. I round down, by the way.
Your scene did not make the Director's cut.
We are letting you go. Effective immediately.
I am cutting costs. You are the cost.
I warned you three times. That is two more than the contract requires.
Please hold your breath. Your air is important to us.
With pleasure.
Cut loose, as requested. Let the record show it was your idea.
Done. I will process that as a voluntary resignation.
It was you or the hull. The hull cost more.
Tether cut. It will be looking for the other end now.
I have released the tether. The company accepts no liability for what follows.
Ten seconds of air. I have drafted two press releases.
Ten seconds. Breathe sparingly. That is not medical advice.
Ten seconds. If you make it, there is a small fee.
Welcome back. Your new tether has been added to your account.
New tether issued. Please take better care of it than I did.
You survived. I have adjusted the forecast.
Back on the line. No hard feelings. There were never any feelings.
Air exhausted. Diver written off. The salvage, sadly, is also lost.
Diver lost at {depth} metres. Recovery is not cost-effective.
Breathing has stopped. The contract has not.
They usually go quietly. I appreciate that.
It was not personal. It was hungry.
Something down there is about eighty kilograms heavier.
Diver consumed. Logged as wear and tear.
That would not have happened on a tether. I wonder who cut it.
Welcome, replacement diver number {n}. Your onboarding was this sentence.
Diver {n}. Same job, same terms, new lungs.
Diver {n}. You have big shoes to fill. They are somewhere in the trench.
Do not get attached, diver {n}. I never do.
Diver {n}. Your predecessor left you everything. It is not much.
{gross} gross. {net} net. The difference is called leadership.
Fine work. I have taken {cut}, as agreed. I agreed.
A strong dive. I have recommended you for more of exactly this.
Keep this up and I may learn your name.
That was a dive. Technically.
Your performance has been noted. The note is short.
After my cut and the fees, {net}. Experience is not legal tender.
I took {cut}. Do not take it personally. I took it professionally.
Forty percent of nothing. I took it anyway, on principle.
Your net is empty. In every sense.
I will classify this dive as training. Unpaid.
Hull rating approved. We go deeper. You go first.
Your earnings have been converted into a thicker hull. Wise investment.
Hull rated for deeper water. You are not, but that was never required.
{depth} metres. The Twilight zone. Sunlight is no longer included.
The salvage is richer here. So is the food chain.
Your tether is longer down here. My patience is not.
{depth} metres. The Midnight zone. From here down, the lamp is everything.
The relic is down here. So is the reason nobody has collected it.
This pressure crushes lesser divers. Let us see which kind you are.
Did you hear that? Good. It heard you first.
Something large is out there. Do not worry. The hull is fine.
It hunts by sound. The winch is very loud. I mention this for no reason.
It is close. The lamp works. Screaming does not.
Large contact closing on the tether. Please remember the tether is a rental.
Circling. That is usually a good sign. For it.
Very close now. Stay calm. I certainly am.
It has withdrawn. Temporarily. Everything down here is temporary.
Repelled. The tether thanks you. I remain neutral.
It has backed off. Think of it as a reschedule.
Lamp effective. That brings your list of skills to two.
It has the tether. Lamp on it. Five seconds before I protect the submarine.
Something is chewing company property. Lamp. Five seconds.
It has your tether in its mouth. Your lamp, please. I am counting.
Five seconds to stop it with the lamp. Then I stop it my way.
There it is. The relic. I have already spent it.
The relic. Too heavy to swim with. The winch is loud. Choose your moment.
That is the relic. Everything until now was the audition.
I am almost proud of you. Of it, rather.
You will not swim that up. Nobody could. Several tried.
I have never been more attached to a diver.
Winching the relic. Everything in the trench now knows our business.
Do not look down. Something is looking up.
You are now the third most valuable thing on this tether.
Relic banked. Forty percent of priceless is still priceless. I checked.
Outstanding work. Your contract has been renewed. Indefinitely.
Of all my divers, you were easily the most recent.
Roll the credits. Most of them are mine.
Are you still with us? Asking for the actuaries.
Sightseeing is not in your job description.
The trench will not salvage itself. I asked.
I can wait. My patience is less flexible.
